description: Moderate uncertainty and reasonable trust create space for anticipatory institutional reform.
Repeated shocks and low trust push institutions into reactive crisis response.
AI automation platforms and digital systems reshape labor regulation education and public services quickly.
Heat flooding drought wildfire and infrastructure fragility stress public budgets and local capacity.
Ageing migration and care demand reshape healthcare labor housing education and fiscal systems.
Trade conflict security risks energy volatility and supply-chain disruption challenge policy resilience.
Civic participation public learning and institutional reform improve legitimacy and adaptive capacity.
